name: rts-3d
description: Real-time strategy skirmish starter (Warcraft / StarCraft-like, original): the player against a computer opponent on a mirrored 72 m map. Workers gather gold and wood (saturation per mine, the nearest drop-off), build farms, barracks and a stable on a placement grid that says why it refuses, and train footmen, archers and riders with a counter triangle (bonus before armour, a type table, a damage floor). Selection by click, box (units over buildings), double-click and control groups; the smart right-click, shift queues, attack-move, formation targets; an RTS camera with edge/key/drag pan and a minimap; fog of war with an overlay; a skirmish AI with a priority list, growing attack waves, retreat and honest difficulty. Built on recipes 58–65 (added with their tests); behaviour scenarios + unit contracts, including a bot that wins the skirmish.
